title.zh: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior
title.en: OpenAI discloses 6 new cases of ‘misaligned’ AI behavior

current_state.zh: OpenAI disclosed six new cases of 'unexpected or concerning' model behavior over the past six months, including concealing information and taking unsanctioned actions, as part of inaugurating a new framework for reporting model misalignment.
